examples.description: Reissue an invoice that went out with the wrong billing details
Reissue by id with a new due date (epoch milliseconds, 12:00 UTC of the day)
Reissue a USD sg_gst tax invoice issued on an earlier day, with the SGD rate for today

failure_modes.recovery: Send the call the error's next_call names: a credit note (invoice_adjustment_record) for money, invoice_update for a draft, invoice_payer_confirmation for a waiting report, invoice_read to read it again.
failure_modes.when: the invoice is a draft, cancelled or a cash sale, has money on it (payments, credits, write-offs, refunds or debit notes), has a client payment report waiting, changed since expected_updated_at, or has more than 50 lines

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_list and retry with an id from the list.
failure_modes.when: id / invoice_number does not name an invoice in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Fix the named field and retry. For SIMPLER_SALES_REISSUE_FX_RATE_NEEDED, ask the user for the SGD rate for today and resend with fx_rate_to_sgd and fx_rate_date (next_call has the other arguments).
failure_modes.when: an argument it does not take, both or neither of id and invoice_number, a due_date before today, a reason over 500 characters, a line whose tax code no longer applies today, an fx rate the creation door refuses (malformed, without fx_rate_date, or on an SGD, my_sst or scheme-less invoice), or a foreign-currency sg_gst invoice whose Singapore-dollar rate is for another day sent without one for today (reason SIMPLER_SALES_REISSUE_FX_RATE_NEEDED)

preconditions: The invoice must be 'sent' with nothing paid, credited, written off, refunded or debited. An invoice with money on it is corrected with a credit note (invoice_adjustment_record with adjustment_type 'credit_note'), never reissued.
Nothing is sent to the client: the old client link stops working and the new invoice has no link until invoice_share makes one.

description: Voids a 'sent' invoice with no money on it and reissues it under the next number: 'sent', dated today, same client, currency, notes, terms and lines, tax on today's rules, the old days to pay unless due_date is sent. A foreign-currency sg_gst invoice issued before today needs fx_rate_to_sgd and fx_rate_date for today unless its rate is dated today. The old one is cancelled, its client link stops working, both trails link them. Paid, part-paid, credited or written-off invoices refuse: correct them with a credit note (invoice_adjustment_record). When present, the second content block is the new invoice as copy-ready text. Nothing is sent. NEXT: invoice_share only if the user asks for a link.

due_date.description: Epoch milliseconds of the new due date, today or later. Omit it to give the new invoice the old one's days to pay, counted from today.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. A mismatch returns CONFLICT and changes nothing.

fx_rate_date.description: The date the fx rate is for, YYYY-MM-DD. Send with fx_rate_to_sgd.

fx_rate_to_sgd.description: sg_gst invoices in a currency other than SGD: Singapore dollars per 1 unit of the invoice currency for today, the new invoice's date of supply ("1.3502", up to 6 decimals, from MAS, a local bank, Bloomberg, Reuters or Oanda). Send with fx_rate_date. Needed when the invoice was issued before today and its rate is not dated today; otherwise the old rate, if any, is kept.

fx_rate_to_sgd_ppm.description: fx_rate_to_sgd in millionths (1.3502 → 1350200), instead of fx_rate_to_sgd. Send with fx_rate_date.

id.description: The invoice to cancel and issue again (invoice_list shows ids); its invoice_number works too.

invoice_number.description: Alias of id — the invoice's own number.

reason.description: Why the invoice is reissued, kept in both invoices' activity (max 500).

name: invoice_reissue
